body:
Yalop!Im the captain of this team,Destroyers!.Ive created this team with some of my mates.We are 4 for the moment,so were looking for people to join our team
Requirements:
-Have a skype account
-Played more that 4 hours one Avicus Network
-Have at least 1.000 K/D(exceptions can be made)
-Be friendly!
Application format
IGN:
K/D:
Time zone:
Position:
Favorite gm(Nebula,walls...)

Languajes.
We would like you to speak spanish,due to all members are from there,though english speaking people can also join

If we decide to accept you,i´ll reply you saying [Accepted]^^
If for some reason youre not in,ill say [Denied]Sorry

Want to hear people!And GL!
